# 🚀 What type of change is this? 🛠️

> 📝 **This is the default template.** Please click one of the links below 🔗 to reload the PR with the correct checklist for your specific change. 🎯

* [🐛 **Load Bug Fix Template**](?template=bug_fix.md) — 🔧 Non-breaking change that fixes an existing issue.
* [✨ **Load New Feature Template**](?template=feature.md) — 🚀 Non-breaking change that adds new functionality.
* [💥 **Load Breaking Change Template**](?template=breaking_change.md) — ⚠️ A fix or feature that introduces breaking changes to existing functionality.
* [♻️ **Load Refactor / Chore Template**](?template=chore.md) — 🧹 Code quality improvements, dependency updates, maintenance, cleanup, etc.
